matches.title: Al Ettifaq vs Al Riyadh
matches.description: Watch Al Ettifaq vs Al Riyadh highlights and goals from Pro League - Saudi Arabia on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 14, 2026. On August 14, 2026 , Al Ettifaq and Al Riyadh faced off in a Pro League encounter that kept fans on the edge of their seats until the very end. The match featured a series of tactical battles and unexpected moments that defined the flow of play throughout an intense evening of football. Early Drama and Opening Salvos The contest ignited in just the 6th minute when Al Riyadh defender Rodrigo Abascal was shown a straight red card. The decision sparked heavy protests from his teammates and forced an early tactical reshuffle, but Al Ettifaq were clinical in exploiting the extra space. In the 22nd minute, Moussa Dembele broke the deadlock, firing home after being played through by a sharp pass from Alvaro Medran . Despite their numerical disadvantage, the visitors refused to collapse. Al Riyadh fought back valiantly as the first half drew to a close. In the fifth minute of added time, Teddy Okou silenced the home crowd by slotting home an equalizer assisted by Bernard Mensah , sending both teams into the tunnel with the score level at 1-1. A Seesaw Battle in the Second Half The second half began with high intensity, and the lead changed hands again in the 54th minute. Moussa Dembele stepped up to the penalty spot and coolly converted his second goal of the match. However, the joy was short-lived for the hosts. Just two minutes later, Bernard Mensah turned from provider to scorer, finding the net in the 56th minute to restore parity at 2-2 and set up a grandstand finish. As managers turned to their benches, Al Ettifaq 's substitutions proved decisive. Rayane Messi , introduced in the 64th minute, made an immediate impact by finding the target in the 79th minute. His goal capped off a period of sustained pressure, putting the home side back in front as the clock ticked toward full-time. Dembele Seals the Hat-Trick The final stages were played in a frantic atmosphere, with the referee adding significant stoppage time. In the 99th minute, Al Ettifaq were awarded another penalty, providing Moussa Dembele with the chance to secure the match ball. He made no mistake from the spot, rifling home his third goal to make it 4-2. After 14 minutes of added time, the final whistle blew, confirming a hard-fought victory for the home side in a six-goal thriller.
